difference.title: Our Difference
difference.description: A client-first approach, clear communication and support through your injury claim. See what makes Buena Park Injury Lawyer different.

sections.heading: What Makes Us Different
paragraphs: ### Client-First Philosophy

To us, putting clients first means clear communication, personalized strategy, and unwavering support from start to finish. We’re present, proactive, and invested—so you feel heard, respected, and confidently represented.
### With you through the process

Whether it’s day one of your injury claim or the final hours of settlement negotiations—or a discussion about trial—we work to keep you informed. [See the step-by-step process](/about/what-to-expect).
### Multilingual & Community-Based
We’re ready to talk about your case with English, Spanish and Korean assistance. [Request a free consultation](/contact).
### Serious injury cases

A serious injury calls for careful preparation and decisions about when to negotiate, when to settle and when further action is needed. Start with a free consultation about what happened and the options available.
### A strategy that starts with your situation

The accident type, injuries, available records and effect on everyday life shape the work that needs to be done. Clear communication means explaining those issues in a way you understand, then identifying the next decision. The aim is a case strategy built around the facts rather than an identical response to every client.
The [questions about hiring a lawyer](/faqs/hiring-a-personal-injury-lawyer) can help you turn these principles into questions about communication, the agreement and responsibility for your case.

sections.heading: The Promise Behind Buena Park Injury Lawyer
paragraphs: We represent people injured in accidents and work to honor your experience as if it were our own. Clear communication, personalized strategy and support throughout the process are the principles behind that commitment.
[Meet Howard Choi](/attorney) and learn who will be responsible for your legal representation.

sections.heading: The 5 Core Values That Power Our Promise
paragraphs: ### Honor
We lead with integrity and go the extra mile to earn your trust and help make things right when it matters most.
### Innovation
We work to make the case process as easy and stress-free as possible for you.
### Empathy
We don’t just talk—we show up. Through the difficult moments of pain or progress, support and communication matter.
### Welcoming
You deserve to feel understood from the start. English, Spanish and Korean assistance helps meet your needs with care.
### Transparency
You deserve answers at every step. We aim to be honest, clear, and direct from day one, so you understand where things stand in your case.

sections.heading: How We Work From Start to Finish
paragraphs: Ever wondered what happens after you call? Follow the process from a free consultation and retainer agreement through gathering records, dealing with insurance, reviewing medical obligations and receiving a settlement.
[See what to expect](/about/what-to-expect). No pressure—honest answers and a clear explanation of the next step.
### See the work behind the claim

Evidence gathering, medical documentation, insurer communications, negotiation and settlement distribution serve different purposes. Understanding that sequence helps you see why records are requested, why some stages take time and what a proposed offer does or does not resolve. Follow the process page for the work and client decisions at each stage.

sections.heading: Support That Moves Life Forward
paragraphs: ### Missed work
Lost wages add stress. A claim can seek compensation for income lost because of an injury, alongside medical bills and other supported losses.
### Medical care
Your injuries and recovery remain central to the claim. Medical records, treatment and the effect on everyday life help explain what happened to you.
### Clear legal help in your words
Clear, direct communication in English, Korean or Spanish helps keep important details from getting lost in translation.
[Explore injury types](/injury-types) or [find your accident practice area](/practice-areas).

process.title: What to Expect From Your Injury Claim
process.description: From your free consultation to receiving a settlement: understand each stage, the work involved and what it means for you.

sections.heading: Your Free Consultation
paragraphs: Your journey begins with a free, no-obligation consultation. This free case review allows you to understand your rights, ask questions, and determine if we’re the right fit for you.
### Our role in this step
We review your accident details, assess the viability of your case, and explain your legal options.
### What this means for you
You can ask questions and understand the proposed next steps before deciding whether to hire the firm. English, Spanish and Korean assistance is available.
[Questions about hiring a personal injury lawyer](/faqs/hiring-a-personal-injury-lawyer)
### The questions the first call should answer

The review starts with what happened, how you were injured and which parties may be responsible. A useful consultation connects those facts with your legal options. You can ask about the investigation, communication and fee arrangement before deciding whether representation is right for you.

sections.heading: Signing the Retainer Agreement
paragraphs: Once we confirm that your case qualifies, the next step is a retainer agreement. The legal team will walk you through the agreement and answer any questions you have.
### Our commitment to you
There is no attorney fee unless there is a recovery. Review the written agreement before representation begins.
### What this means for you
We don’t expect you to sign anything immediately, and we won’t pressure you. The agreement sets out the representation you are choosing.
[Understand the Zero Fee Guarantee](/about/zero-fee-guarantee)
### Questions to resolve before you sign

Who will work on the case? How is the attorney fee calculated? How will the office communicate with you? The agreement and the explanation around it should make those responsibilities clear. Ask for clarification rather than signing terms you do not understand.

sections.heading: Launching Your Case
paragraphs: Once you choose us as your legal advocates, we start building your case. The work includes gathering evidence, contacting insurance companies, and obtaining police and medical records relevant to your claim.
### Keeping you informed
The office will explain the next steps and how to communicate updates or ask questions about your case. Keep the office informed about new treatment and correspondence.
### What this means for you
You can focus on your recovery while the firm handles the legal process and communications within the agreed representation.
[Answers during an ongoing case](/faqs/ongoing-case-faqs)
### What the early investigation brings together

The accident account, available photographs, witness information, police records and medical-provider information form the starting file. The office can identify what remains to be obtained and which requests need a response. Tell the office about documents or contact from an insurer rather than assuming it already has them.
The [ongoing-case FAQs](/faqs/ongoing-case-faqs) explain the updates to discuss with the office once representation has begun.

sections.heading: Property Damage Assistance
paragraphs: After a collision, property damage may involve rental cars, vehicle repairs and the value of a totaled vehicle. The property-damage claim is one part of the aftermath of an accident.
### Keeping the vehicle records
Before your vehicle is towed, take a photo of the tow truck’s information card, ask where your car is being taken, and remove any valuables.
### What this means for you
Discuss which property-damage tasks are included in your representation. Keep repair estimates, rental receipts and insurance correspondence together.
[Read about diminished value claims](/blogs/diminished-value-claim-california)
### Separate the vehicle decision from the injury claim

A repair estimate or total-loss valuation concerns the vehicle. Medical treatment and the impact of an injury concern the person. Keep the records for both, and understand which settlement or release you are being asked to accept. Discuss the proposed documents before treating a vehicle payment as the end of the entire claim.

sections.heading: Getting the Medical Care You Deserve
paragraphs: Your health is the top priority. Injuries need to be evaluated, treated and documented while the claim is being investigated. Your treating medical professionals determine the care appropriate for you.
### Document the effect of your injury

Document your injuries from day one, including how they affect you physically, mentally, and psychologically. Be transparent with doctors about your symptoms, pain levels, and the effect on daily life.
### What this means for you
Medical records help explain both the treatment received and the ongoing impact of an injury. Tell the office about new providers and changes in your medical condition.
[Medical treatment after an accident: common questions](/faqs/medical-treatment-after-an-accident)
### Keep treatment and claim information consistent

Tell your treating professionals about the symptoms you actually experience and how they affect daily activities. Keep the office informed about new providers, referrals and missed appointments. The records should show the course of recovery, including changes and continuing limitations, rather than just the first visit.

sections.heading: Dealing With the Insurance Companies
paragraphs: The claim brings together medical records, police reports, bills, and other evidence to present a demand to the insurance company. The demand explains the full impact of the injuries, medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering.
### Negotiation and the next decision
The objective is fair compensation from the responsible party. If the insurer does not offer a fair resolution, the next discussion may involve filing a lawsuit and preparing the case for court.
### Protect the record
Avoid posting about the incident or injury on social media. Insurance companies may use posts to challenge injury claims by arguing that activities contradict the claimed limitations.
[Questions about insurance claims](/faqs/insurance-claim)
### Understand what a demand needs to explain

A demand is supported by records: what caused the incident, what injuries followed and what losses can be documented. Medical expenses, lost earnings, pain and suffering and future needs may raise different questions. Reviewing the evidence and the insurer’s response helps identify what is agreed and what remains disputed.

sections.heading: Reducing Your Medical Bills
paragraphs: Outstanding medical bills and liens can affect the compensation left after a claim is resolved. Reviewing those obligations is an important part of understanding the eventual distribution.
### Reviewing outstanding balances

Medical-bill and lien negotiations may involve hospitals, medical providers and others asserting a right to repayment. The aim is to resolve the outstanding obligations and improve the client’s net recovery where possible.
### What this means for you
The settlement amount and the amount you take home are different figures. The distribution needs to account for the agreed attorney fee and applicable deductions before funds can be disbursed.
[Case value and settlement questions](/faqs/case-value-and-settlement-process)
### Look at the net recovery

A proposed settlement is a gross figure. The outstanding medical obligations and agreed attorney fee affect the amount remaining for you. Reviewing those items before distribution helps you understand the closing statement. A lower medical balance may improve the net amount, but a particular reduction cannot be assumed.

sections.heading: Receiving Your Settlement
paragraphs: Before settlement funds can be disbursed, you’ll need to sign a release agreement finalizing the settlement terms.
### The final step
Once the case is resolved, the closing statement provides a breakdown of the settlement distribution. The remaining funds can be distributed once the required closing steps are complete.
### What this means for you
You have the final say on accepting a settlement. We will not pressure you to accept an offer. The proposed settlement and distribution should be explained before you make that decision.
[Understand the settlement process](/faqs/case-value-and-settlement-process)
### Review the closing documents

The release sets out the settlement terms; the closing statement explains the distribution. Ask about anything you do not understand in either document. The final step is more than agreeing to a number: you should understand the proposed resolution and the amount remaining after the listed deductions.

fees.title: No Attorney Fee Unless There Is a Recovery
fees.description: A free consultation and a contingency fee arrangement. Understand the fee promise, the retainer agreement and the settlement distribution.

sections.heading: We Only Get Paid If There Is a Recovery
paragraphs: Buena Park Injury Lawyer works on a contingency fee basis. There is no attorney fee unless there is a recovery. The fee arrangement is set out in the written retainer agreement.
This approach makes the attorney fee dependent on the result of the claim. Start with a free consultation to discuss the accident and whether the firm can help.

sections.heading: Your Free, No-Obligation Consultation
paragraphs: Your journey begins with a free case review. The consultation allows you to understand your rights, ask questions, and determine if we’re the right fit for you.
The office reviews the accident details, assesses the viability of the case, and explains the available legal options. You do not need to decide immediately whether to hire the firm.

Use the review to ask who would work on your claim, what information is needed and how the office would communicate with you. The consultation is a chance to understand the representation and the fee arrangement together—not simply to hear an estimate of what a case might be worth.

sections.heading: Understand the Agreement Before Signing
paragraphs: Once the firm confirms that your case qualifies, the next step is a retainer agreement. The legal team will walk you through the agreement and answer your questions.

Personal injury lawyers generally calculate a contingency fee as a percentage of the recovery. Discuss the fee structure during the free consultation and read the written terms before agreeing to representation.
We don’t expect you to sign anything immediately, and we won’t pressure you. [Read the questions about hiring a lawyer](/faqs/hiring-a-personal-injury-lawyer).

A clear explanation of the percentage and the work covered is more useful than a general slogan. Ask how the attorney fee would be calculated if compensation is recovered. If a term is unclear, have it explained before you decide to sign; the written agreement is the reference for the representation.

sections.heading: Know How a Settlement Is Distributed
paragraphs: The amount of a settlement and the amount you receive are not always the same. Outstanding medical bills or liens and the agreed attorney fee affect the final distribution.
Once the case is resolved, a closing statement provides a breakdown of the settlement distribution. Reviewing outstanding medical obligations is part of understanding the net recovery.
[Read the case value and settlement FAQs](/faqs/case-value-and-settlement-process).

The closing statement is the place to see those figures together: the total settlement, the attorney fee, the medical obligations and the amount remaining for you. Medical-bill or lien negotiations can affect that remaining amount. Ask the office to explain the proposed distribution rather than comparing only the headline settlement figure.
For the distinction between a claim’s overall value and a proposed resolution, read the [case-value explanation](/blogs/how-much-is-my-personal-injury-case-worth-california).

sections.heading: You Decide Whether to Accept a Settlement
paragraphs: You have the final say on accepting a settlement. We will not pressure you to accept an offer. Before funds can be disbursed, a release agreement finalizes the settlement terms.
The fee promise does not predict a case outcome or a settlement amount. The evidence and circumstances of the claim determine the available options.
[Follow the full case process](/about/what-to-expect) or [request a free consultation](/contact).
